dct:description: A special collection of aggregated columns from the 2022 5-year ACS variables at the census tract level selected for use with the Displacement Vulnerability Mitigation Tool (DVMT). Please see the column metadata for the description of the columns.

#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2022_acs_5yr_tract_dvmt/download -p /data/mdc_2022_acs_5yr_tract_dvmt/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2022_acs_5yr_tract_dvmt
cd /data/mdc_2022_acs_5yr_tract_dvmt

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download specific variables from the census API, reformat census json to csv,
# and load as individual tables into postGIS with ogr2ogr.
if do_update = 1 then
  wget -O download/total_population.json" https://api.census.gov/data/2022/acs/acs5?get=B01001_001E&key=%24CENSUS_API_KEY&for=tract%3A%2A&in=state%3A12&in=county%3A086"
awk '{gsub(/\[|\]|.$/,""); print;}' download/total_population.json | awk '{ for(i=1; i<=1; i++) sub("\",\"", "\"|\"") } 1' |
  sed -e "s/\",\"//g" -e "s/\"state.*\"/\"geoid\"/1" -e "s/\"|\"/\",\"/g" | awk '!/null/' | 
  ogr2ogr -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres_connection>" csv:/vsistdin/ -nln total_population
